messages:
rory: Heads-up: Orbitly wants to list our new connector in their marketplace and asked about a launch package: benchmark post + short webinar + marketplace how-to. can we scope?

jamie: Sounds good. two quick asks: 1) product needs to approve GA connector artifacts, 2) we should propose a single performance narrative (latency/cost) not 5+ charts.

luca: Eng update: connector build + e2e tests green. I can run a 72h steady-state run and produce median/p95 latency + cost-per-1k-tokens. need permission to use a synthetic prompt set.

tasha: Marketing: Ill draft the landing + blog. prefer a results-first headline plus a short how-to for enabling the listing in Orbitly. will need partner logo files and a 1-sentence customer quote.

priya: Webinar ops: partner prefers Thurs mornings (PT). were leaning towards 30m: 12m demo (prerecorded) + 12m panel Q&A + quick CTA. recording will feed into social clips.

infra-bot: Perf job started. outputs will land in s3://redwood-markets/orbitly/bench/2915000000/ by EOD.

rory: Leads: Orbitly will route marketplace leads to their CRM. we must mirror a lead into SFDC for attribution and marketing nurture. security: no PII leakage beyond consent.

legal-bot: POA signed. Consent language approved: "I agree to be contacted by Redwood and Orbitly about this connector listing." Do not send logs.

jamie: Routing plan suggestion: 1) Orbitly -> partner webhook (whitelisted IPs + signed JWT header), 2) webhook posted -> we validate JWT, then create SFDC Lead with fields: LastName, Company, Email, Campaign (Orbitly-Launch-2915), UTM params, Consent__c, Partner__c=Orbitly. 3) suppress downstream exports unless consent=true.

luca: For security, we prefer JWT signed by Orbitly's private key; we will verify with their public JWK. also rotate our callback secret every 60d.

tasha: Promo checklist: blog post (benchmark + how-to), webinar page + nurture emails (days: 7,2,1), 1-pager sales cheat sheet, 3 social clips, CTAs with UTM utm_source=orbitly&utm_campaign=orbitly-2915.

priya: Draft timeline:
- Day 0: perf run starts
- Day 2: perf summary to marketing
- Day 4: landing + blog draft
- Day 6: webinar registration live
- Day 10: launch + sync with Orbitly PR (embargo until launch window)

rory: Action owners:
- luca: perf run + raw logs + methodology note (due in 2 days)
- tasha: blog draft + landing copy + sales 1-pager (due in 4 days)
- jamie: webhook spec + JWT verification plan + SFDC mapping (due in 2 days)
- priya: webinar page, speaker runbook, recording plan (due in 6 days)

luca: Perf notes: will use 512-token median prompts, tokenization consistent with runtime, measure GPU seconds and estimate $/1k tokens. will publish csv and a short reproducibility appendix.

jamie: sample webhook payload (Orbitly -> our ingestion):
POST /redwood/orbitly/webhook HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <JWT-signed-by-orbitly>
{
  "first_name": "Alex",
  "last_name": "Kim",
  "company": "Pinwheel",
  "email": "alex.kim@pinwheel.co",
  "utm_source": "orbitly",
  "utm_campaign": "orbitly-2915",
  "interest": "connector help",
  "consent": true
}

legal-bot: Reminder: if consent=false, do NOT create marketing leads. store minimal record for logging only.

tasha: Can we get a partner quote for the blog (one-line)? Orbitly marketing said they can provide a short quote from the product lead.

priya: Webinar format confirmed: prerecord + 15m live Q&A. schedule target Thurs May 6 10:00am PT. registration page by May 1.

rory: Final sync planned Wed 9am PT to review landing, security mapping, and promo calendar. flag blockers here before EOD. :rocket:
